newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia LNG producer signs pact with Taiwan's CPC.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia LNG producer signs pact with Taiwan's CPC.

text.p: Liquefied natural gas (LNG) producer Malaysia LNG Tiga Sdn Bhd on Tuesday signed a memorandum of intent to supply gas to the Chinese Petroleum Corporation (CPC) of Taiwan with up to two million tonnes per annum for 20 years, starting in 2001.
State-owned Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) said in a statement on Tuesday that the shipments will take place on a cif basis, using tankers owned by Petronas Tankers Sdn Bhd.
MLNG Tiga is a joint venture between Petronas, the state government of eastern Sarawak state, Nippon Oil Co Ltd, Occidental LNG (Malaysia) Ltd and Shell Gas BV.
CPC has been importing LNG from Malaysia since 1995 under an existing agreement with MLNG Tiga. Under the deal, MLNG will supply 2.25 million tonnes per year for 20 years.
